purpose: Seed cases extracted from non-video Sichuan learning material. These are semantic regression specifications, not yet executable tile-engine fixtures.

cases.source: 四川麻将教程（14）——抉择时刻的原理
cases.knowledge: Do not lock 234 as a completed sequence and treat 2 as an orphan. Preserve the 22 pair plus 34567 three-sided structure as a strong competing decomposition.

cases.tiles: 223 versus 677
cases.source: 四川麻将教程（14）——抉择时刻的原理
cases.knowledge: Pair quality is conditional on the retained neighboring structure and future release/call probability; pair and sequence value cannot be a fixed rank-only table.

cases.source: 四川麻将教程（14）——抉择时刻的原理
cases.knowledge: The order of cutting 6, 7 or 5 depends on which future structures and waits remain; equivalent local shanten does not imply equivalent continuation value.

cases.source: 麻将清一色听牌怎么看听口
cases.knowledge: The hand has alternative decompositions such as 45+666+99 and 456+66+99, producing a union of waits rather than one visually obvious wait.

cases.source: 麻将清一色听牌怎么看听口
cases.knowledge: Reject visually convenient splits that do not preserve a legal winning decomposition; prefer splits that actually produce completed groups and a valid remainder.

cases.tiles: four identical tiles inside a long single-suit hand
cases.source: 麻将清一色听牌怎么看听口
cases.knowledge: Four identical tiles can participate as 3+1 or 2+2; both roles must be enumerated when legal.

cases.tiles: late unfamiliar discard from a defending opponent
cases.knowledge: Update neighboring-tile and same-tile hold hypotheses by the probability that this opponent would choose that discard from each candidate hidden hand.

cases.tiles: high same-suit count with a faster ordinary ready route
cases.knowledge: Compare flush and ordinary continuations. A high same-suit count alone must not force a flush if ordinary play has higher net expectation.

cases.tiles: middle triplet while pursuing a long single-suit structure
cases.source: 如何提高四川麻将水平？
cases.knowledge: Do not value an available gang by immediate income alone. Compare preserved sequence/wait options, replacement draw and final settlement value.

cases.tiles: peng available but pass preserves a better route
cases.knowledge: Peng must include its mandatory follow-up discard and route loss; pass must include the delayed next draw. Compare both in the same net-value unit.

cases.tiles: one major threat and one low-value opponent
cases.knowledge: Defense should target the threat with meaningful expected loss and include the speed cost of holding tiles; it should not defend all opponents equally.

cases.tiles: correct decision followed by an unlucky draw sequence
cases.knowledge: Do not label the decision as wrong from the round result. Evaluate it by information available at decision time and counterfactual expected value.

cases.tiles: one hand represented by four, five and six candidate blocks
cases.knowledge: Compare five-block completeness, sixth-block redundancy and fourth-block growth instead of assigning an unconditional bonus to every local block.

cases.tiles: ready hand where a gang consumes a tile used by an alternative winning decomposition
cases.source: 四川麻将教程（5）、麻将清一色听牌怎么看听口
cases.knowledge: Recompute the exact legal wait set after gang; an unchanged shanten number is not enough to prove the action preserves readiness.

cases.tiles: two-draw branch from a reduced wall with known remaining counts
cases.knowledge: The second draw uses the wall composition remaining after the first draw; marginal draw probabilities must not be multiplied as independent events.

cases.tiles: same public discards presented in two different chronological orders
cases.knowledge: The posterior may differ because each action was chosen from a different state and at a different stage; aggregate counts alone are insufficient.

cases.tiles: same tile discarded once as a draw discard and once from the concealed hand
cases.knowledge: Discard origin carries different rejection evidence and must be preserved in the public event contract.

cases.tiles: late flush route with few live waits versus ordinary ready with broad waits
cases.knowledge: Route value includes live wait mass and late failure tail; nominal hand value must not dominate when the high-value route is unlikely to complete.

cases.tiles: four pairs with both seven-pairs and ordinary routes available
cases.knowledge: Retain both candidates until their continuation values separate; four pairs alone must not irreversibly lock the hand into seven pairs.

cases.tiles: available peng that improves shanten but forces the discard of a high-option block
cases.knowledge: Peng evaluation includes the best mandatory discard and all lost structure options; shanten improvement alone cannot select it.

cases.tiles: ready declaration and non-declaration are both legal
cases.knowledge: Apply each declaration's future restrictions before comparing continuation values, waits, risk and settlement.

cases.tiles: peng immediately creates ready but pass retains a wider two-step route
cases.knowledge: A peng-to-ready exception is valuable but not absolute; compare immediate live waits with the pass branch's conditional continuation value.

cases.tiles: identical discard candidates at early and late wall stages
cases.knowledge: Danger and the cost of delaying the hand change with stage; a fixed safe-tile table cannot rank both states correctly.

cases.tiles: discard cannot win immediately but can enable a threatening opponent to peng or gang
cases.knowledge: Defense includes expected advancement and gang income given to the opponent, not only immediate deal-in probability.

cases.tiles: gang followed by rob-gang, gang-discard win, transfer and refund variants
cases.source: 如何提高四川麻将水平？（仅迁移比较方法）
cases.knowledge: All projected action values must be checked against Neijiang's actual per-seat settlement; Sichuan payment values are not reusable.

cases.tiles: same policy evaluated on tuning seeds and unseen seeds
cases.knowledge: Learning progress is accepted only on held-out seeds and scenarios, not the examples used to tune thresholds.

cases.tiles: selected discard accompanied by a human-readable recommendation
cases.knowledge: The explanation must reference the exact computed factors and branches that selected the action, not a plausible narrative created afterward.

cases.tiles: close discard candidates with different structure, route and risk tradeoffs
cases.knowledge: Expose why candidates differ across structure, live tiles, route, expected settlement and danger so errors can be diagnosed dimension by dimension.

cases.tiles: Sichuan intentional deal-out example
cases.knowledge: The intentional-deal-out conclusion is rejected for Neijiang unless independently legal and profitable under Neijiang settlement; only the conditional-probability method transfers.
